items.title: Is Eli Lilly (LLY) Priced Below Its Cash Flow Potential?
items.summary: Eli Lilly has ridden a powerful obesity and diabetes drug story to a share price of US$1,437.29. That raises a straightforward question for investors who own or follow the stock: Is that market value meaningfully backed by the cash flows the pharmaceutical group is expected to produce over time, or has sentiment moved ahead of the underlying economics?
